audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own why-text: Level 3 read Skill while whys[2] says his all-in beats yours; Levels 4-5 read Darius while whys[3] says 'it evens out'; First item read Darius while whys[5] says 'even at first item'; 2+ items read Darius while whys[6] says 'you take 2+ items'.
audit.why: Packet chart is Darius/Darius/Darius/Skill/Skill/Skill/Poppy — the shape the prose already argues, and the shape a 47.72% win rate with a scaling tank supports.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one group with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it outright: zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and no numbers.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and still 16s maxed — the longest cooldown in the lane and the entire basis for 'when do I step up'. Crippling Strike is 5s, Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80 with a refresh on a kill.
audit.corrected: 26s, 5s and 120s written into dosFull[0], dontsFull[1], the cooldown block, report[5] and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] has him hooking you with E and detonating an 'empowered Q' at level 1 — he has one ability at level 1 and Apprehend does not exist yet. 'Empowered Q' appears twice more; there is no such thing. Hemorrhage at five stacks enrages him for massive attack damage. The Crippling Strike auto-reset tell and the Apprehend-cancels-your-channel interaction were both absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: P bleeds and enrages at max stacks; W is a next-attack reset; E passively shreds armour and actively hooks enemies to him; R is true damage scaling with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes on a kill. An E pull during Keeper's Verdict yanks you out of the channel — the mirror wrote the same interaction from Darius's side.
audit.corrected: Level-1 rewritten around Decimate only, the enrage named properly, the auto-reset given as the step-back tell, and the pull named as the channel-breaker.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game text says 'build resists' as the answer to his kill button.
audit.why: Noxian Guillotine is true damage and Apprehend passively shreds a percentage of armour — resistances are exactly the wrong answer to the execute. Health is what moves you off the threshold. The anti-heal advice, by contrast, is correct: Decimate's blade heals him.
audit.corrected: Late-game and wants.you[2] now say health over resists against the execute, with anti-heal kept for the Decimate healing.

edits.before: His all-in start. E-stun after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — that whole window is yours to trade in.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Apprehend pulls you out of your R channel — never ult in its range.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: At five Hemorrhage stacks he enrages for huge attack damage — leave before the fifth tick.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. E-stun after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed — his only gap-close, and it drags you out of your R channel. - Crippling Strike: 5s auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. - Noxian Guillotine: 120s, refreshed by a kill.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in start. E-stun after it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 and pulls you out of your R channel; Noxian Guillotine is true damage.

edits.before: Darius hooks you with E into five Hemorrhage stacks and an empowered Q — your single ability and flat base damage lose the level-1 all-in outright.
edits.after: His Decimate blade out-damages your single Q and heals him off it, so the level-1 all-in is his outright — take it and you lose the trade.

edits.before: He out-trades you at 2: his bleed stacking and empowered Q out-DPS your Q+E before your wall-stun can matter.
edits.after: He out-trades you at 2: Hemorrhage stacking toward the enrage out-DPSes your Q+E before a wall-stun can matter.

edits.before: Hook you in with E pull and stack five Hemorrhage for the empowered crit Q
edits.after: Hook you with Apprehend and stack five Hemorrhage to trigger the enrage

edits.before: Tank up first item so his Noxian Guillotine can't execute you out of even trades

edits.before: Darius owns levels 1-3 hard and you have to respect it — his E pull yanks you into Hemorrhage stacks and an empowered Q that out-damages everything you have. Do not walk into the outer edge of his Q where it heals him; sidestep the spin and only step up to last-hit. Your one trick is E into a wall: if he flashes his pull or steps up to spin, a wall-slam stun flips a trade, but you cannot win the raw all-in here so don't fish for it greedily.
edits.after: Darius owns levels 1-3 and you have to respect it — Apprehend yanks you into Hemorrhage stacks, and at five he enrages for huge attack damage. Do not stand in the blade at the edge of his Q: that half heals him. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1, so the moment he burns it you have a long window. Your one trick is E into a wall — a slam stun flips a trade, but you cannot win the raw all-in, so don't fish for it.

edits.before: This is where you tilt favored: Darius is a dashless juggernaut, so unlike most lanes your W dash-deny is dead weight — but your percent-HP Q, E wall-stun and tank stats mean you out-last him once you have items. He falls off if he hasn't snowballed, and you stay relevant through CC and disruption. Build resists, never let him reach the Guillotine threshold cleanly, and you win the extended trade his bleed used to win.
edits.after: This is where you tilt favored: Darius is a dashless juggernaut, so unlike most lanes your W dash-deny is dead weight — but your percent-HP Q, E wall-stun and tank stats mean you out-last him once you have items. Stack health rather than pure armour: Apprehend shreds resists passively and Noxian Guillotine is true damage, so HP is what keeps you off its threshold while your CC does the work.

notes: There is no 'empowered Q' in Darius's kit — the empowered state is Hemorrhage's enrage at five stacks, which grants attack damage; three strings claimed the Q version and whys[0] also had him using Apprehend at level 1, before he owns it. The armour advice was actively wrong: Apprehend passively shreds a percentage of armour and Noxian Guillotine is true damage, so health beats resists against his kill button (the anti-heal line stays right — Decimate's blade heals him). Four chart rows contradicted their own why-text and the packet chart; flipped as one group.
